readmeMarkdown:
BIOME: Design with an elephant. Scout with a falcon. Review with a goldfish. Map with a cartographer. Build with a beaver. Blend with a chameleon. Polish with a craftsman. Inspect with a woodpecker. Clean with the reaper.

Install  ·  Autonomous Pipeline  ·  Agent Roster & Superpowers  ·  Skill Reference  ·  Documentation  ·  GitHub


**BIOME** is an autonomous, production-grade software delivery ecosystem engineered for AI coding assistants. Born from Google's foundational Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) and evolved into a multi-agent engineering platform, BIOME eliminates the fatal flaws of autonomous AI development: **contextual amnesia**, **hallucinated package APIs**, **robotic slop**, **broken half-dark UIs**, and **uncontrolled zombie processes**. --- ## The Paradigm Shift: Standard AI vs. BIOME | Failure Vector in Standard AI | The BIOME Engineering Guarantee | Primary BIOME Agent / Invariant | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Model Amnesia**: Forgets earlier client requirements across iterations. | **The Memory Vault**: Cumulative client features are permanently locked in `.biome/requirements_ledger.json`. | 🏛️ `.biome/requirements_ledger.json` | | **Token Bloat & Context Exhaustion**: Reading entire codebases into conversation context. | **Falcon Reconnaissance & Cartography**: Probes AST signatures and caches module topology in `.biome/codebase_topology.json`. | 🦅 The Falcon & 🗺️ The Cartographer | | **The "God Agent" Spaghetti**: Single conversational LLM edits files blindly while debating in chat. | **The Elephant Iron Rule**: The conversational orchestrator is **strictly prohibited from writing code**. All code is built by isolated, ephemeral builder pods. | 🐘 The Elephant & 🦫 The Beaver | | **Hallucinated Package APIs**: Importing deprecated methods or non-existent library flags. | **Live Registry Verification**: The builder queries live npm/PyPI/crates.io releases to pin real APIs before writing imports. | 🦫 The Beaver Builder | | **Robotic AI Code & Copy Slop**: Clumsy compound names (`*Helper`, `*Manager`), chatty comments, and corporate buzzwords (`seamless`). | **Human-Grade Craftsmanship**: Enforces clean idiomatic verbs/nouns and purges AI marketing puffery. | 🦎 The Chameleon Stylist | | **Broken & "Half-Dark" UIs**: Duplicate controls scattered between navbars and sidebars; dark headers with blinding white cards (`#FFFFFF`). | **Apple HIG & Executive SaaS Laws**: Enforces Navigational Singularity, 4-tier dark elevation, bounded modals, and defensive tables. | 🎨 The UI/UX Master Craftsman | | **Blind Unchecked Commits**: Trusting shallow unit tests that test only happy paths. | **Zero-Context Diff Pecking**: Relentless inspection of raw `git diff` across 6 security and spec vectors before commit. | 🪵 The Woodpecker Inspector | | **Zombie Subagents**: Background agents lingering in memory, conflicting over shared files. | **The Reaper Protocol**: Single-use ephemeral workers destroyed immediately upon task delivery (Zero-Zombie Rule). | ⚡ The Reaper Protocol | --- ## Install BIOME is packaged as a universal plugin compatible with **Antigravity**, **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, and **Cursor / Windsurf**. ### Antigravity CLI & IDE Extension ```sh agy plugin install https://github.com/asteria-core/biome ``` For the **Antigravity App** and **VS Code Extension**, trigger `/plugin` in chat or follow the [Harness Setup Guide](docs/harnesses.md). ### Claude Code Install directly from GitHub via the Claude Code CLI: ```sh claude plugin marketplace add asteria-core/biome claude plugin install biome@biome ``` Or invoke within an active session: ```text /plugin install biome --marketplace asteria-core/biome ``` ### OpenAI Codex CLI ```sh codex plugin marketplace add asteria-core/biome codex plugin add biome@biome ``` ### Cursor & Windsurf Install directly into your workspace: ```sh npx skills add asteria-core/biome --agent cursor ``` --- ## The Autonomous Pipeline Run the entire engineering lifecycle end-to-end automatically with a single command: **Autonomous End-to-End Delivery** ```text /biome Build multi-tenant voucher management with WhatsApp activation logs and executive dark mode. ``` ### End-to-End Architectural Dataflow ``` [User Strategic Request] │ ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ 🐘 THE ELEPHANT │ ◄─── State Anchor (.biome/state.json) & Anti-Amnesia Ledger └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ (1. Scout codebase AST signatures without context bloat) ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ 🦅 THE FALCON │ ───► Probes routes, interfaces, types & schemas └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ (2. Returns compact signatures) ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ 🐘 THE ELEPHANT │ ───► Drafts specification (docs/designs/.md) └──────────────┬───────────────┘ [Strictly zero production code] │ (3. Fan-out to adversarial zero-context reviewers) ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 🐠 THE GOLDFISH SWARM │ │ ┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ │ │ 🥊 The Critic │ │ 💡 Inventive Catalyst │ │ 👓 Naive Reader│ │ │ │ (Adversarial UX/State)│ │ (Soviet TRIZ Solver) │ │ (No Assumptions│ │ │ └────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────┘ └────────────────┘ │ │ ┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ │ │ 🏗️ Design Critic │ │ 🔭 Zoom-Out Architect │ │ 📋 Tech Lead │ │ │ │ (Infra & Scalability) │ │ (Simplicity & YAGNI) │ │ (Readiness Gate│ │ │ └────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────┘ └────────────────┘ │ │ ┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ │ │ 🔬 Codebase Details │ │ 📐 Structural Auditor │ │ ✍️ Style Editor │ │ │ │ (Anti-Hallucination) │ │ (Symmetry & Hierarchy)│ │ (Brevity/Clarity│ │ │ └────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────┘ └────────────────┘ │ └──────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘ │ (4. Synthesizer aggregates findings) ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ 🐘 AUTO-RESOLVE │ ───► Settles trade-offs, locks spec as APPROVED └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ (5. Maps topology and partitions mutation plan) ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ 🗺️ CARTOGRAPHER │ ───► Reads/Caches .biome/codebase_topology.json └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ (6. Generates deterministic target mutation plan) ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ 🎯 INDEXER │ ───► Emits .biome/project_index.json └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ (7. Phase-Isolated Ephemeral Build across Domain Pods) ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 🦫 THE BEAVER BUILDER │ │ ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Domain Pods: [Database] ──► [Backend API] ──► [Web/Mobile] ──► [E2E] │ │ │ │ Invariants: Real Package Verification · Micro-Architecture · Tests │ │ │ └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ └──────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘ │ (8. Active working git diff) ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 🪵 THE WOODPECKER AUDITOR │ │ Pecks at git diff across 6 vectors: │ │ [Spec Fidelity] · [Security/Taint] · [Edge Cases] · [Micro-Architecture] │ │ [Anti-Slop (Chameleon)] · [UI/UX Craftsmanship (Apple HIG Laws)] │ └──────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘ │ ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐ [REJECTED] [APPROVED] │ │ ▼ ▼ [Beaver Self-Healing Loop] [Atomic Git Commit] │ ▼ [⚡ THE REAPER] (Kills all ephemeral sessions) ``` --- ## The Agents of BIOME ### 1. 🐘 The Elephant (Context Orchestrator & Living Spec Engine) * **Orchestrator**: [`skills/biome/SKILL.md`](skills/biome/SKILL.md) (The Elephant Orchestrator Engine) * **Context Mode**: Deep conversational memory and architectural steward. * **The Elephant Iron Rule**: The Elephant is **strictly prohibited from writing, generating, or modifying production source code**. Its sole responsibility is strategic discovery, specifications, and coordination. * **State Anchor**: Durable phase checkpoints are written to `.biome/state.json`. If context compaction occurs in the host harness, the Elephant automatically recovers state and resumes from `active_phase`. ### 2. 🦅 The Falcon (Rapid Reconnaissance Scout) * **Skill**: `/biome-falcon ` | **Persona**: [`agents/falcon.md`](agents/falcon.md) * **Context Mode**: Ultra-fast, low-token reconnaissance. * **Superpower**: Probes deep project directories, AST signatures, interfaces, and database models to extract compact contracts without dumping massive raw code into conversational context. ### 3. 🗺️ The Cartographer (Repository Topology Engine) * **Skill**: `/biome-cartographer` | **Persona**: [`agents/cartographer.md`](agents/cartographer.md) * **Context Mode**: Cached codebase knowledge engine. * **Superpower**: Analyzes module boundaries, entrypoints, and internal dependency graphs, writing an immutable topology cache to `.biome/codebase_topology.json`. Prevents redundant filesystem scans across subagents. ### 4. 🐠 The Goldfish Reviewer Swarm (10 Specialized Personas) Zero-context, stateless review subagents that evaluate specifications cold with zero conversational memory or developer justifications: 1. **🥊 The Critic ([`agents/critic.md`](agents/critic.md))**: Cynical Lead Auditor attacking state transitions, latency traps, unhandled failures, and contract flaws. 2. **💡 The Inventive Catalyst ([`agents/inventive_catalyst.md`](agents/inventive_catalyst.md))**: Applies Soviet TRIZ principles to identify and eliminate false architectural compromises without quality trade-offs. 3. **👓 The Naive Reader ([`agents/comprehension.md`](agents/comprehension.md))**: Audits with zero assumed institutional knowledge, flagging undefined acronyms and ambiguous logic. 4. **✍️ The Technical Style Editor ([`agents/style.md`](agents/style.md))**: Technical copy editor enforcing clarity, precision, brevity, and objective framing. 5. **🏗️ The Hostile Design Critic ([`agents/design_critic.md`](agents/design_critic.md))**: Attacks system architecture, horizontal scaling bottlenecks, infrastructure economics, and single points of failure. 6. **🔭 The Skeptical Minimalist ([`agents/zoom_out.md`](agents/zoom_out.md))**: Relentlessly eliminates unnecessary complexity using YAGNI and maximizes existing library reuse. 7. **📋 The Pragmatic Tech Lead ([`agents/implementation_readiness.md`](agents/implementation_readiness.md))**: Verifies that execution instructions are 100% unambiguous with zero unresolved design decisions. 8. **🔬 The Codebase Quality Auditor ([`agents/codebase_details.md`](agents/codebase_details.md))**: Verifies that documentation strictly reflects live code without doc-to-code hallucinations. 9. **📐 The Structural Layout Architect ([`agents/structural.md`](agents/structural.md))**: Validates markdown heading hierarchy, table formatting, and template compliance. 10. **Intermediate Synthesizer ([`agents/synthesizer.md`](agents/synthesizer.md))**: Aggregates parallel reviews, eliminates duplicate feedback, and standardizes citations. ### 5. 🦫 The Beaver (Phase-Isolated Ephemeral Surgical Builder) * **Skill**: `/biome-build` | **Persona**: [`agents/beaver.md`](agents/beaver.md) * **Context Mode**: Ephemeral builder isolated from conversation history. * **Multi-Domain Pod Swarm**: Partitions complex cross-stack mutations into isolated domain pods executed in strict order: $$\text{Database Pod} \longrightarrow \text{Backend API Pod} \longrightarrow \text{Web/Mobile Pod} \longrightarrow \text{E2E Pod}$$ * **Superpower Invariants**: - **Live Dependency Verification**: Checks actual npm/PyPI registry APIs before importing packages to prevent hallucinated functions. - **Micro-Architecture**: Decomposes sprawling logic into modular single-responsibility files. - **Self-Healing Test Loops**: Runs local test suites autonomously up to 3 times to repair runtime breaks. ### 6. 🦎 The Chameleon (Anti-Slop & Human-Grade Stylist) * **Skill**: `/biome-chameleon ` | **Persona**: [`agents/chameleon.md`](agents/chameleon.md) * **Context Mode**: Anti-slop craftsmanship auditor. * **Superpower**: Inspects code and UI copy to purge all AI fingerprints: - Banish robotic compound naming: No `*Helper`, `*Manager`, `*ProcessorActionHandler`. Mandates clean verbs and nouns (`login()`, `getUser()`). - Banish AI marketing puffery in UI: No `seamless`, `empower`, `revolutionary`, `cutting-edge`. Mandates clear, human terminology. - Banish chatty obvious comments: Strips `// function to calculate sum`. ### 7. 🎨 The UI/UX Master Craftsman (Apple HIG & Executive SaaS) * **Skill**: `/biome-ui-craftsman ` | **Persona**: [`agents/ui_craftsman.md`](agents/ui_craftsman.md) * **Standard**: [`resources/document_standards/ui-craftsmanship-standard.md`](resources/document_standards/ui-craftsmanship-standard.md) * **Superpower**: Relentlessly audits web, mobile, and dashboard interfaces against **The Eight Frontend Laws**: 1. **Navigational Singularity & Zero Redundancy**: Global controls (Theme, Language, Profile, Logout) MUST reside in exactly ONE canonical location (pinned to sidebar footer OR header dropdown, never duplicated across both). Banish duplicate stacked page titles. 2. **Apple HIG 4-Tier Elevation & True Dark Mode**: Strictly bans "half-dark" interfaces with dark headers but blinding white cards (`#FFFFFF`). Enforces layered dark elevation (`slate-950` canvas, `slate-900` cards, `slate-800` modals) and dual-theme semantic tokens. 3. **Modal Viewport Containment**: Enforces `max-h-[85vh]`, internal scrollable body, and permanently visible sticky action footers. 4. **Defensive Table Layout**: Enforces `whitespace-nowrap` on codes, dates, and badges within responsive horizontal scroll containers (`overflow-x-auto min-w-[...]`). 5. **Smart Customer Lookup**: Instant reactive lookup rendering rich customer preview cards (Avatar, Device, Subscription Tier, WhatsApp direct link). 6. **Asset & Icon Integrity**: Pure SVG / Lucide components with explicit dimensions. Strictly bans raw unrendered font ligatures (`content_copy`). 7. **Platform Context Fidelity**: UI copy strictly matches the target platform (no web extension references inside native mobile apps). 8. **Bilingual RTL/LTR Architecture**: Full bidirectional mirroring with dedicated Admin & Company Settings tab. ### 8. 🪵 The Woodpecker (Zero-Context Code Diff & Security Inspector) * **Skill**: `/biome-woodpecker [spec.md]` | **Persona**: [`agents/woodpecker.md`](agents/woodpecker.md) * **Context Mode**: Stateless pre-commit auditor. * **Superpower**: Pecks relentlessly at the raw `git diff` across 6 dimensions: 1. *Spec & Boundary Fidelity & Anti-Amnesia*: Guarantees all locked features in `.biome/requirements_ledger.json` remain preserved. 2. *Security Hardening*: Taint analysis, injection checks (SQLi, command injection, path traversal), and secrets leakage. 3. *Pathological Edge Cases*: Null/nil dereferences, unhandled async Promise rejections, resource leaks, and race conditions. 4. *Micro-Architecture*: Modular files, type-safety rigor (bans `any`), and rejection of vanity tests. 5. *Anti-Slop Craftsmanship*: Validates Chameleon standards across modified files. 6. *UI/UX Craftsmanship*: Validates adherence to the Eight Frontend Laws before allowing commits. ### 9. 🏛️ The Memory Vault & Requirements Ledger * **Anchor**: `.biome/requirements_ledger.json` | **Template**: [`resources/requirements_ledger.template.json`](resources/requirements_ledger.template.json) * **Superpower**: Protects against AI requirement amnesia. Every cumulative feature requested by the client is logged, categorized, and permanently locked. The Woodpecker automatically blocks any build that drops or regresses locked requirements. ### 10. ⚡ The Reaper Protocol (Zero-Zombie Lifecycle Invariant) * All worker subagents are strictly ephemeral single-use instances. * Immediately upon completing an audit, build, or review task, worker sessions are terminated and destroyed, preventing orphaned background processes from corrupting subsequent turns. --- ## The 15 Standalone Skills Every capability in BIOME can be invoked individually as a standalone granular command:
Skill CommandPurpose & ResponsibilityPrimary Output Artifact
/biome Orchestrate the complete autonomous end-to-end delivery pipeline. Full feature branch, tests, and atomic commit.
/biome-brainstorm Clarify a raw concept and stress-test trade-offs with fresh reviewers. concepts_brief.md
/biome-draft Draft living architectural design specifications section-by-section. docs/designs/<feature>.md
/biome-critic Run the unsparing Critic Goldfish to expose state and contract flaws. critic_audit_report.md
/biome-review Execute a multi-stage review with 10 zero-context Goldfish specialists. review_findings.md
/biome-resolve Negotiate trade-offs, apply spec fixes, and secure APPROVED status. Formal spec sign-off (APPROVED).
/biome-falcon Rapid low-token reconnaissance of codebase types, schemas, and routes. Signature summaries in chat.
/biome-cartographer Map repository modules, dependencies, and external entrypoints. .biome/codebase_topology.json
/biome-index Parse approved spec and topology to emit partitioned mutation plans. .biome/project_index.json
/biome-build Execute surgical, phase-isolated code modifications with self-healing tests. Mutated source code & test receipts.
/biome-ui-craftsman Audit frontends against Apple HIG, true dark mode, and SaaS standards. ui_audit_report.md
/biome-chameleon Audit code and UI copy to eliminate robotic AI naming and marketing puffery. chameleon_audit_report.md
/biome-woodpecker Audit the raw working git diff across 6 pecking vectors before commit. woodpecker_audit_report.md
/biome-bootstrap Generate, format, and verify documentation across an existing codebase. Hierarchical README contract trees.
/biome-review-loop Run a configured group of specialized reviewers for custom tasks. Synthesized feedback report.
--- ## Architectural Invariants & State Files All execution state is managed transparently inside the project's root `.biome/` directory: ```text .biome/ ├── state.json # Durable phase checkpointing for post-compaction recovery ├── requirements_ledger.json # Immutable client requirements vault (Anti-Amnesia) ├── codebase_topology.json # Cached repository module and dependency map └── project_index.json # Partitioned target mutation plan for domain pods ``` --- ## Learn More - [Setup & Harness Integration](docs/harnesses.md): Installation and capabilities across Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. - [Getting Started Guide](docs/getting_started.md): The comprehensive workflow and operational rules. - [UI/UX Craftsmanship Standard](resources/document_standards/ui-craftsmanship-standard.md): The Eight Frontend Laws for modern executive SaaS design. - [System Architecture](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/blob/main/docs/designs/architecture.md): Deep-dive into agent lifecycles, schemas, and state machines. - [Testing & Quality Verification](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/blob/main/TESTING.md): Verification limits, harness matrix, and test suite execution. --- ## License This project is licensed under a dual-licensing structure: * **[BIOME License v1.0 (Source-Available)](LICENSE)**: Copyright © 2026 Asteria Studio.
